# TeachingTip

Header: `winui/ui/dialogs/TeachingTip.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/dialogs/TeachingTip.hpp`.

A card that points at a control (or sits against the window) to teach something about it.

The element itself takes no room where it is placed in the tree. While open, its card floats above the window, placed against [target()](#target) by [placement()](#placement) and [placement_alignment()](#placement_alignment). It falls back to the other sides when there is no room. The card holds an optional icon, the title and subtitle, optional content, optional hero content, and up to two buttons. The tip owns its content and hero content. The target is a non-owning pointer that must outlive the tip or be cleared first. The target usually exists only once the tree is built, so set it right before opening, or give the spec a [`.target`](#target) handle, which links in either build order.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Control<ui::Button> show;
ui::Control<ui::TeachingTip> tip;

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .content = {
        ui::Button{.text = "Show TeachingTip", .on_click = [&] { tip->set_open(true); }, .control = show},
        ui::TeachingTip{.title                 = "Save automatically",
                        .subtitle              = "Your work is saved to the cloud as you go.",
                        .action_button_text = "Got it",
                        .close_button_text  = "Close",
                        .target                = show,
                        .placement             = ui::PopupPlacement::Below,
                        .on_closed             = [](ui::PopupCloseReason) { /* remember it */ },
                        .control               = tip,
                        .content               = ui::Text{.text     = "Turn it off in Settings.",
                                                          .wrapping = ui::TextWrapping::WrapWholeWords}},
    },
});

// Or imperatively, next to the target in the same window:
auto  stack  = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto* target = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Show TeachingTip"));
auto* t      = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TeachingTipControl>());
t->set_title("This is the title");
t->set_subtitle("And this is the subtitle");
t->set_light_dismiss(true);
target->on_click([t, target] {
    t->set_target(target);
    t->set_open(true);
});
```

## `ui::TeachingTip`

A card pointing at a control, or at the window, to teach something. Builds a [ui::TeachingTipControl](#uiteachingtipcontrol), which takes no room in layout. Set its target with [`.target`](#uiteachingtip-target), or through [`.control`](#uiteachingtip-control) once the target exists. Without a target it sits against the window's edge.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Control<ui::Button> save_button;
ui::Control<ui::TeachingTip> tip;

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{ .content = {
    ui::Button{ .text = "Save", .control = save_button },
    ui::TeachingTip{ .title                = "Saving automatically",
                     .subtitle             = "We save your changes as you go.",
                     .close_button_text = "Got it",
                     .placement            = ui::PopupPlacement::Below,
                     .control              = tip },
}});
tip->set_target(save_button);
tip->set_open(true);
```

### TeachingTipControl

```cpp
TeachingTipControl()
```

A closed, untargeted tip with no text, no content and no buttons (only the corner "X"). Not hit-test visible: it draws nothing where it sits, so a press there goes to what is under it.

```cpp
~TeachingTipControl() override
```

Sets the icon, in its own column left of the titles. A glyph shows at its own size, which is 20 DIPs for a [Symbol](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#symbol). Anything else fills a 20 DIP square.

```cpp
const IconSource& icon() const
```

The icon left of the titles; empty (the default) drops the icon column.

Takes ownership of the content under the titles and returns a non-owning observer. Replaces and destroys any previous content; nullptr clears it.

```cpp
Element* content() const
```

Takes ownership of the hero content, typically an image, drawn edge to edge across the card's top or bottom, and returns a non-owning observer. Replaces any previous hero.

```cpp
Element* hero_content() const
```

```cpp
void set_action_button_text(std::string text)
```

Sets the action button's text; empty hides the button. The same goes for the close button. The action button only raises on_action_button_click; the close button also closes the tip.

```cpp
ButtonControl* alternate_close_button() const
```

The corner "X". It shows only when there is no close button text and light dismiss is off ([alternate_close_visible()](#alternate_close_visible)).

### alternate_close_visible

```cpp
bool alternate_close_visible() const
```

Whether the corner "X" is on screen: no close button text and light dismiss off.

### enabled

```cpp
bool enabled() const
```

A disabled tip grays out its action, close and corner buttons, which then take no input. Its content keeps its own state, and light dismiss and Escape still close it.

### set_target

```cpp
void set_target(Element* target)
```

The element the tail points at; nullptr for an untargeted tip. Non-owning: a target that is destroyed while the tip points at it leaves the tip untargeted. Setting it makes the next layout re-decide the placement.

### target

```cpp
Element* target() const
```

The current target (non-owning); nullptr (the default) for an untargeted tip.

### set_placement

```cpp
void set_placement(std::optional<PopupPlacement> placement)
```

Sets the side tried first; nullopt (the default) tries above the target first, and puts an untargeted tip at the bottom of the window. The next layout re-decides the placement.

### placement

```cpp
std::optional<PopupPlacement> placement() const
```

The side tried first, before the other sides; nullopt by default. For an untargeted tip, the window edge the card sits against.

### set_placement_alignment

```cpp
void set_placement_alignment(PopupPlacementAlignment alignment)
```

Sets how the card lines up with the tail; the next layout re-decides the placement.

### placement_alignment

```cpp
PopupPlacementAlignment placement_alignment() const
```

How the card lines up with the tail on its side; Center by default. Leading runs the card right (or down) from the tail, Trailing left (or up). For an untargeted tip, which end of the window edge the card sits at.

### set_placement_margin

```cpp
void set_placement_margin(Thickness margin)
```

Sets the placement margin; takes effect at the next layout.

### placement_margin

```cpp
Thickness placement_margin() const
```

The placement margin, in DIPs; zero by default. For a targeted tip, it is the gap between the target and the card. Only the side the card is on counts, such as `top` for a card above the target or `left` for one to its left. For an untargeted tip, it is the gap from the window's edges, added to the fixed edge inset. A card centered on an axis moves by `left - right` or `top - bottom`.

### set_tail_visibility

```cpp
void set_tail_visibility(AutoVisibility visibility)
```

Sets when the tail is drawn.

### tail_visibility

```cpp
AutoVisibility tail_visibility() const
```

When the tail is drawn; Auto (the default) draws the tail only for a targeted tip.

### effective_placement

```cpp
PopupPlacement effective_placement() const
```

The side the open tip settled on, Below for an untargeted one. Only meaningful after a layout pass with the tip open. When no side fits, the card is centered over the target and this reports Above.

### effective_placement_alignment

```cpp
PopupPlacementAlignment effective_placement_alignment() const
```

How the open tip lines up with its tail on that side.

### tail_shown

```cpp
bool tail_shown() const
```

Whether the tail is drawn for the current placement.

### set_light_dismiss

```cpp
void set_light_dismiss(bool enabled)
```

Turns light dismiss on or off; false by default. With it on, a click outside or Escape closes the tip with LightDismiss, and the card fills with in-app acrylic instead of its solid background. The tip also takes keyboard focus while open, and the corner "X" is hidden.

### light_dismiss

```cpp
bool light_dismiss() const
```

Whether light dismiss is on; see [set_light_dismiss()](#set_light_dismiss).

### is_open

```cpp
bool is_open() const
```

Whether the tip is open; false by default. Stays true when an [on_closing()](#on_closing) handler cancels.

### set_open

```cpp
void set_open(bool open)
```

Opens or closes the tip. Opening fires [on_opened()](#on_opened) at once and places the card at the next layout. A tip that fits nowhere then closes with Programmatic. Closing this way reports Programmatic, and [on_closing()](#on_closing) can cancel it. Setting the current state does nothing.

### on_action_button_click

```cpp
void on_action_button_click(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fires when the action button is clicked; the tip stays open.

### on_close_button_click

```cpp
void on_close_button_click(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fires when the close button or the corner "X" is clicked, before the tip closes with CloseButton.

### on_closing

```cpp
void on_closing(Callback<Decision(const PopupClosingArgs&)> handler)
```

Fires with the reason before an open tip closes; return [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to keep the tip open.

### on_closed

```cpp
void on_closed(Callback<void(PopupCloseReason)> handler)
```

Fires with the reason once the tip has closed (not when canceled).

### on_opened

```cpp
void on_opened(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fires from set_open(true) as the tip opens. There is no opening animation to wait for.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Always AutomationRole::Pane. Screen readers reach the floating card the way they reach any popup's content.

### automation_name_fallback

```cpp
std::string automation_name_fallback() const override
```

The title, when no accessibility name is set.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Always [Size](../core/size.md){0, 0}: the tip takes no room where it sits in the tree.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Nothing to arrange in place; the card is placed by the popup.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws nothing in place. The card draws above the window.

### clear_dirty_override

```cpp
void clear_dirty_override(DirtyFlags flags) override
```

Also clears the content, hero and buttons, which are not ordinary children.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Forwards the tick to the card's children (button animations) while open.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

## Enumerations

### TeachingTipHeroPlacement

```cpp
enum class TeachingTipHeroPlacement
```

Which edge of the card the hero content sits at: Auto puts it at the edge away from the tail.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Auto` | The edge away from the tail; the top when there is no tail at the top. |
| `Top` | Always across the top of the card. |
| `Bottom` | Always across the bottom of the card. |
